info.title: Permguard Control Plane catalog
info.description: The Control Plane's zone and ledger catalog over REST. Every refusal is a WireError; a surface gated by an allow list may answer 401 or 403 with a WireDenial before any handler runs.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page; listing is whole without `page` and `size`. An unknown, repeated or malformed parameter is refused `invalid_argument`.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size; `0` is no size, as if absent. An unknown, repeated or malformed parameter is refused `invalid_argument`.

200.description: The zones, whole or one page.

400.description: An unknown, repeated or malformed query parameter (`invalid_argument`).

401.description: No usable credentials, on a surface gated by an allow list. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Mutual-TLS realm="permguard"`.

403.description: A known peer without standing, on a surface gated by an allow list.

post.description: Under `catalog.read` on the ledger (WP-7.10): the archive of a zone holding that ledger alone, a canonical CBOR map {1 manifest, 2 bundle} whose manifest is the COSE_Sign1 `permguard.ledger.export.v1` the Host signs under `host.operations`, binding the source Host, the refs, the counts and the bundle's digest; the bundle carries every object a ref reaches and every head statement as stored. Audited `ledger.exported`.

200.description: The archive, base64url, and what its manifest binds.

400.description: A body that is not a closed JSON `ExportBody` (`invalid_argument`).

401.description: No usable credentials, on a surface gated by an allow list. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Mutual-TLS realm="permguard"`.

403.description: A known peer without standing, on a surface gated by an allow list.

404.description: Nothing answers to the name or id (`not_found`).

500.description: A ledger's store could not be read (`internal`), or the export was made and its audit record could not be written (`mutation_unrecorded`).

503.description: The archive would pass what one message carries, or the Host composes no `host.operations` signer for this plane (`unavailable`): nothing was signed.

name.description: The zone or ledger name: a-z, 0-9, `-`, `_`; letter first, alphanumeric last, 3 to 63 characters; a GUID-shaped name is refused with `invalid_name`.

request_id.description: The change's request id, chosen by the caller and repeated by a retry: the same id with the same body learns the first answer, with another body is `request_id_reused` (WP-7.3a).

expected_revision.description: On a rename only, required there: the revision the record was read at; another is `409 revision_conflict`. A create naming one is `invalid_argument`.

NameBody.description: The body of a create or a rename, closed: an unknown or repeated member is `invalid_argument`.
NameBody.x-grpc-note: The body of a create or rename: gRPC carries `name`, `request_id` and, on a rename, `expected_revision` as fields of each request (CreateZoneRequest, RenameZoneRequest, CreateLedgerRequest, RenameLedgerRequest), no standalone message.

id.description: The permanent identity, a GUID minted at creation.

name.description: The human name, unique across the deployment, free to change.

revision.description: 1 at creation, one more at each change: what a rename or a delete names as `expected_revision` (WP-7.3a).

id.description: The permanent identity, a GUID minted at creation.

zone_id.description: The zone this ledger belongs to, by id.

name.description: The human name, unique within the zone.

default_ref.description: The ref this ledger considers its default line, `main` unless said otherwise.

serving_members.description: On `GET …/ledgers/{ledger}` only: the members this Host coordinates whose `policy.mirror` task covers the ledger, with what it observed of them (WP-4.4). Assignment and observations, not a guarantee that a member serves now; absent from every other answer.

revision.description: 1 at creation, one more at each change: what a rename or a delete names as `expected_revision` (WP-7.3a).

state.description: `archived` is read, pulled and mirrored and refuses a push (`409 ledger_archived`); `active` takes pushes (WP-7.3b).

task_id.description: The `policy.mirror` task that covers the ledger.

declared_assurance.description: What the member declared: a compatibility claim, never rendered as verified.

assurance_binding_status.description: The coordinator's appraisal, without its evidence; `null` when the manifest signs no binding.

lease_state.description: `live` while a session's lease runs, `none` otherwise.

last_session_at.description: The last session leased for the task, from the coordinator's clock, RFC 3339. Optional; `null` is absent.

progress.description: The member's last report, member-reported; `null` before the first.

ServingMember.description: One member assigned to serve a ledger (WP-4.4).

expires_at.description: When the binding stops admitting, RFC 3339.

ServingAssurance.description: An assurance binding's status, without its evidence (WP-4.4).

by.description: Who vouches: the profile declared, the verifier or the approving operator.

report_seq.description: The member's number for the report.

reported_at.description: When the member says it reported, RFC 3339.

received_at.description: When the coordinator received it, RFC 3339.

state.description: What the member says of this ledger; `null` when the report does not name it. Optional; `null` is absent.

checkpoint_digest.description: The checkpoint the member says it verified last. Optional; `null` is absent.

stale.description: Past its session bound, or of another epoch: explicitly stale.

ServingProgress.description: A member's last report of a ledger, member-reported (WP-4.4).

request_id.description: The change's request id, repeated by a retry (WP-7.3a).

expected_revision.description: The revision the ledger was read at; another is `409 revision_conflict`.

StateBody.description: The body of an archive or a restore, closed.
StateBody.x-grpc-note: gRPC carries `request_id` and `expected_revision` as fields of ArchiveLedgerRequest and RestoreLedgerRequest, no standalone message.

ExportBody.description: The body of an export: nothing, closed, so a cross-site form cannot make one.
ExportBody.x-grpc-note: gRPC carries the zone and the ledger as fields of ExportLedgerRequest and ExportZoneRequest, no standalone message.

id.description: The ledger's id at the source.

refs.description: How many refs the manifest binds.

objects.description: How many objects of its closure the bundle carries.

statements.description: How many head statements the bundle carries.

archive.description: The archive: a canonical CBOR map {1 manifest, 2 bundle}, base64url without padding; bytes on gRPC.

zone_id.description: The zone's id at the source.

bundle_digest.description: `sha256:` over `permguard.ledger.export.bundle.v1\n` and the bundle, as the manifest binds it.

x-grpc-unmapped.note: wraps one `Zone` in `zone`; REST answers the bare `Zone`
wraps one `Ledger` in `ledger`; REST answers the bare `Ledger`
wraps the `Zone` list in `zones`; REST answers the bare array
wraps the `Ledger` list in `ledgers`; REST answers the bare array
